# Sourcegraph

Sourcegraph is a code intelligence platform that enables developers to search, understand, and manage code across large codebases.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sourcegraph/.

## Actions

- **Check Site Settings Edit Permission** (read-only): Check whether site settings can be edited through the api.
- **Compare Commits** (read-only): Compare two commits in a repository and retrieve their file diffs.
- **Get Commit Details** (read-only): Get detailed information about a specific commit in a repository.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Retrieve information about the currently authenticated user.
- **Get File Contents**: Fetch the contents of a specified file on the default branch.
- **List Repositories**: List repositories on the sourcegraph instance.
- **List Repository Files**: List all files and directories in a repository path.
- **List repository languages**: List languages used in a repository.
